hero.name: Avinash Jha
hero.subtitle: 3+ years building mission-critical Fintech & SaaS platforms at scale.

paragraphs: I am Avinash Jha, a passionate Full Stack Developer based in Pune with expertise in Python, Django, React Native, and AWS. Over the past three years, I have delivered high-impact web and mobile solutions across the fintech sector, building scalable, secure, and automation-driven systems.

At Easebuzz, I engineered products that streamlined financial operations—developing centralized communication systems, advanced admin dashboards, automated KYC workflows, and integrated payment gateway solutions across multiple platforms. My work has powered over 7.5 million monthly interactions and improved operational efficiency for enterprises and SMEs.

Work.work_para_1: On a mission to build scalable, secure, and user-friendly software that solves real-world problems. Here's a snapshot of my work experience and impact so far.

Current.title: Full Stack Software Development Engineer
Current.info_para_1: Joined Easebuzz in 2022, contributing to web, mobile, and API development across multiple fintech products. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable features, optimize workflows, and enhance customer experience.
job_points: Developed a centralized communication system in Django with AWS and third-party APIs (SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Webhooks, OBD Calls, Push Notifications), driving 7.5M+ monthly interactions.
Engineered a Society Admin Dashboard for streamlined product management; fully Dockerized the solution including web client, backend, and PWA mobile app.
Revamped a semi-automated KYC workflow handling 1000+ cases/day, reducing manual processing and providing real-time merchant onboarding updates.
Integrated Netbanking, Wallet, and EMI payment modes into the Easebuzz Payment Gateway ecosystem.
Built Payment Gateway SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Cordova, and Ionic.
Integrated HDFC Plugin and Gateway, creating the company's first PSP application.
Implemented Chatbot and NPS survey integrations, generating 400+ monthly leads.
Created and deployed Easebuzz ePOS cross-platform app (5000+ downloads).
Current.info_para_2: My initiatives have resulted in measurable performance gains, reduced operational workload, and enhanced enterprise-level integrations for partners like IRCTC, BigBasket, Zoho, Shopify, and others.

prev_job_info: Integrated APIs for merchant verification (Aadhar, PAN, Bank, GST), improving accuracy and compliance.
Contributed to the Easebuzz Appstore, a subscription-based platform for merchant productivity tools.
Built 'Easelink', a Django + Postgres URL shortener for internal products.
Developed an alcohol delivery application connecting customers with shopkeepers across Mumbai.
Collaborated with over 20 local businesses, handling both tech and business outreach.
